snippet.title: Nauts Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Official Nauts release trailer. 

Nauts is a space action roguelike. Run and develop your civilization in a mysterious and dangerous universe. Knowledge will be your best tool: explore and discover what is hidden in to the Cosmos while surviving as many dangers that will appear on your journey.

To support us don't forget to add Nauts to your Steam wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/480?utm_source=youtube
